title: The Railway Children
author: E. Nesbit
description: Three children befriend a railway community while hoping for their father’s return.
rights: Source edition: public domain in the United States. Listed creative contributors screened for India, UK and EU; original licence retained.
editionCredits: Produced by Les Bowler, and David Widger
longDescription: Imagination, friendship and the discovery of a wider world make this a welcoming reading choice across generations. Everyday experiences take on fresh importance through the characters’ perspectives. The original language and historical context are retained in this complete edition.

authorInfo.bio: Edith Nesbit was an English writer and poet, who published her books for children and others as E. Nesbit. She wrote or collaborated on more than 60 such books. She was also a political activist and co-founder of the Fabian Society, a socialist organisation later affiliated to the Labour Party.
